completeBeginner.label: Complete Beginner
completeBeginner.description: Your path starts from zero — alphabet, basic phrases, and core vocabulary.
completeBeginner.descriptionGeneral: Your path starts from zero — the core objects of the field and the vocabulary to talk about them.

someBasics.label: Some Basics
someBasics.description: You know a few things. Your path skips absolute basics and focuses on building structure.
someBasics.descriptionGeneral: You know a few things. Your path skips the introductions and focuses on turning fragments into a structure.

elementary.label: Elementary
elementary.description: Solid foundation. Your path jumps into grammar patterns and practical sentences.
elementary.descriptionGeneral: Solid foundation. Your path moves straight into the working machinery of the subject.

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.description: You already have foundations. Your path focuses on fluency and complex structures.
intermediate.descriptionGeneral: You already have foundations. Your path focuses on depth, synthesis, and the harder cases.
